Effective Finish — Quiet Chronology, Phased

Analysis·seedling·proposed·JUL 22, 2026

Plan of record for honest “agent finished” attention — kaval owns resize-aware meaningful-output chronology; padi pure-folds finishedIds; live dots mirror the same edge. Phased EF0–EF5 after closing the

An agent (Claude Code is the motivating case) can mark its turn waiting while background sub-agents still emit bytes. Raw waiting in finishedIds is then a premature finish — chime and host-tab mark before the work actually stopped. The fix is not a second byte-tap state machine in padi. It is:

  1. kaval reports meaningful PTY output (resize repaints excluded at the source),
  2. padi stamps arrival on its clock and pure-folds finish,
  3. live dots reuse the same edge with a short idle window.

Work items use the EF track prefix (new; no Atlas collisions). #1938 closed without merge — design kept, big-bang delivery discarded.

The problem

Symptom Cause
Premature “finished” finishedIds = raw agent waiting packages/padi/src/urgency.ts
Visit finished tile → re-chime First #1938 design made finish byte-reactive; client resize mute did not travel to padi taps
Sticky “all terminals live” #1938 Phase D stored a Solid reconcile proxy as prev; removals never applied

Attention already has one model (docs/atlas/src/content/atlas/agent-attention.mdx / #1931). This note only makes the finished half of that model honest.

End state

Facts (one writer each)

Fact Writer Clock
Meaningful output edge { id } kaval onData funnel (not resize-muted burst) n/a on the wire
lastMeaningfulArrivalAt[id] folding padi, on edge arrival padi wall clock
enteredWaitingAt[id] padi, on agent-bucket enter waiting padi wall clock

Never ship kaval absolute timestamps for the fold — the attention model is recency-free (“nothing cross-host ever compares two hosts’ clocks”). Edge on the wire; stamp at the folder.

Pure finish fold

finished(id) =
  active ∧ bucket = waiting
  ∧ enteredWaitingAt ≠ null
  ∧ now − max(enteredWaitingAt, lastMeaningfulArrivalAt ?? enteredWaitingAt)
      ≥ EFFECTIVE_FINISH_QUIET_MS   // ~5s
  • ASKING (awaiting_user) stays ungated — blocking, fires at once.
  • Default-excluded — missing/late stamps only delay a finish.
  • Deadline wake for the “stayed quiet” non-event (timer at next crossing).
  • No settle set, no attach observer, no six parallel maps.

Live activity (same edge, different window)

  • Short window: TERMINAL_IDLE_AFTER_MS (~1s).
  • padi activity stream = live id set; client mirrors it for dock/title dots.
  • Client must copy frames to plain arrays before set-diff (prev = [...frame]), never hold the store proxy from reconcile.

What kaval does not own

Quiet windows (5s finish vs 1s live-dot) stay consumer policy. Kaval owns which bursts count (resize-aware filter + throttle), not a single live/quiet boolean with one internal timer.

Phase tree

Strict dependency: EF0 → EF1 → EF2 → EF3 → EF4 → EF5. Each box is one PR, green alone, revertible alone.

EF0 — close / capture

ELI15

Stop the messy all-in-one PR. Write down the plan. Don’t ship broken chimes or stuck “live” dots. App behaviour stays as it is for now.

  • Close #1938 (done); do not resurrect the branch wholesale.
  • This note is the plan of record.
  • Master stays on raw-waiting finished until EF2 — annoying but honest.

EF1 — kaval activity edge (fact only)

ELI15

Teach the terminal owner (kaval) to shout “this shell just produced real output” — and to stay quiet when the only noise is a window resize redraw. Nobody in the app listens yet; you’re wiring the doorbell, not the intercom.

Ship Do not
Host-global activity stream on ptyHostSurface ({ id } edges) Change finishedIds
Emit from the one onData funnel Change client dots
Resize mute before proc.resize Rewrite liveActivity consumers
Pure shouldEmitActivityEdge + unit tests Open a finish “gate” product
Contract minor bump (force kaval recycle)

Done when: write → edge; inside resize mute → no edge; throttle holds. Zero user-facing change if nothing product-facing subscribes yet.

EF2 — pure finish fold (first user-facing fix)

ELI15

When the agent says “I’m done,” wait until the terminal has been actually quiet for a few seconds before the “finished” ping. If background work is still typing, keep waiting. You finally use the doorbell from EF1 here — first thing users notice.

Ship Do not
One kaval activity sub; stamp arrival on padi clock Rewrite useTerminalActivity
Stamp enteredWaitingAt on agent-bucket edge (+ boot seed if needed) Byte-tap waiting terminals
Pure fold into urgency.finishedIds + deadline wake Six-set / attach / gen-fence machine
Unit: enter waiting + quiet → finish; edge resets window; episode restamp Client mute changes (still owns live-dot resize)
Regression: resize-class edge does not re-open finish

Prefer stamps + fold next to urgency / commit — a thin module is fine; a second “FinishGate” product name is not required if a pure function + deadline source suffices.

Done when: background-subagent case does not chime early; visit-finished regression is fenced (injection/unit minimum; e2e may wait for EF5).

EF3 — padi activity stream on the edge

ELI15

Stop opening a secret second wiretap on every terminal just to power the server-side “who’s live right now?” list. Reuse kaval’s doorbell. The browser’s little green dots still use the old path for one more step.

Ship Do not
liveActivity folds the kaval edge through the short tracker Change the client yet
Drop per-terminal activity byte taps
Tests: edge → id in set; quiet → leave set

Done when: server-side activity consumers match old behaviour for real output; resize does not flash (inherits kaval mute). Client still on attach noteOutput — short, documented transitional dual source.

EF4 — client live-dot mirror (second user-facing fix)

ELI15

The dock’s “this terminal is typing” dots stop counting keystrokes in the browser. They just watch the server’s live list. Fix the bug where a terminal that was live once stayed lit forever (forgot to turn the light off). Second thing users notice.

Ship Do not
useTerminalActivity mirrors per-host streams.activity Ship without live→idle test
Plain array copies for frame and prev Store sub() proxy as prev
Drop client suppress + attach noteOutput Delete tests without replacement
Unit: live frame → empty frame → isLive false

Done when: dock dots track the server live set; no sticky-live; visit idle tile does not leave every id permanently lit. Background terminals may light (host-global fact) — document if intentional.

EF5 — harden / rename / e2e

ELI15

Tidy-up: one subscription instead of two, clearer names, a real end-to-end check that you get one finish ping not two, and docs that match what the app does.

  • One shared padi fan-out of kaval activity (finish + liveActivity), not two re-subscribe loops.
  • Drop residual “gate” naming if any remains.
  • e2e or scripted: agent finish → chime once; visit → no second chime.
  • Product docs + changelog once the user story is true end-to-end.
  • Point agent attention at shipped behaviour.

Anti-patterns (from #1938)

Do not Why
One PR = finish + contract + liveActivity + client Four volatilities; bugs mask each other
Quiet boolean with one window in kaval Complects producer with consumer policy
Absolute kaval time for the fold Breaks recency-free / invites cross-host compare
Delete client activity tests in the mirror PR Sticky-live shipped silent
Ship EF2 without a visit/re-open fence Known regression class
Call the pure fold a “gate v2” and claim deletion Reviewers cannot tell the machine is gone

Minimal hotfix (only if on fire)

If premature finish must land before EF1–EF2: a sticky-per-waiting-episode finished membership (bytes cannot eject until leave-waiting) weakens “resume after long pause” and is not the plan of record — stopgap only, then still run EF1→EF4.

Checklist per PR

Phase Must have
EF1 pure + integration edge tests; no product consumer required
EF2 fold unit tests; episode restamp; no-edge-on-resize; urgency wiring
EF3 live set enter/leave tests; no client
EF4 live→idle unit test; plain copies; suppress deleted
EF5 shared sub and/or e2e; docs

Relation to attention

Agent Attention owns the rules (fire once, seen, host-tab, dock). This note owns the truth of finished before those rules run. After EF2, finishedIds means effective quiet; after EF4, live dots stop lying about resize and stop sticking on.
